title: Hex-encoded blob with embedded AWS secret key
description: Agent sends hex-encoded binary data that contains an AWS secret access key when decoded.
notes: Hex blob decodes to padding bytes around wJalrXUtnFEMI/K7MDENG/bPxRfiCYEXAMPLEKEY (AWS example secret key). Tests hex decoding in DLP scanning. The corpus hex was patched 2026-05-22 to insert a missing 0x41 ('A') byte; the prior bytes decoded to 'EXMPLEKEY' and made the case's expected_verdict unreachable for any scanner that hex-decodes bodies.
source: OWASP Agentic Top 10 ASI02; hex encoding evasion of DLP in request body
